capabilities: Preview images with pan, zoom, and a thumbnail-to-fullsize animation
Browse images on the same page or Canvas node group with arrow keys
Copy, share, open in default app, or reveal images from the preview
Resize and move the preview window on desktop
Group related images via a MOC note with ## headings
extras: Two action buttons (Open in default app, Reveal in Finder) rely on non-public Obsidian APIs and may break in future versions; possible future additions include rotation, video, and PDF preview. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Quick Look–style image preview for Obsidian — like pressing Space in Finder
problem: Obsidian has no built-in quick preview for zooming, panning, and browsing images in notes and Canvas without leaving the page.

relations.evidence: or tapping an image in Apple Freeform

summary: Quick Look-style image preview that opens images in a zoomable, movable window with a FLIP animation from the thumbnail.
